name: Grosvenor House
insider_take: This iconic Dubai Marina tower isn't just another luxury hotel—it's a vertical city where Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum once lived in the Royal Suite, and where the world's first Apartments by Marriott concept was born.
whats_special: Standing 48 stories tall, Grosvenor House was Dubai Marina's first residential-style luxury hotel, featuring spacious apartment-style suites with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. The hotel houses three award-winning restaurants, including Buddha Bar's first Middle East location, and sits directly on Dubai Marina Walk—the world's largest man-made marina.
pro_tip: Book a Marina View suite on floors 35+ for unobstructed yacht views, and time your arrival for sunset when the marina's 200+ skyscrapers create a golden canyon effect that's pure Instagram gold.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct access to Dubai Marina Mall and the Dubai Tram system, making it a perfect base for reaching JBR Beach in 5 minutes or the Palm Jumeirah in 15 minutes. The rooftop infinity pool offers 360-degree city views, while the marina promenade below hosts weekend markets and yacht charter opportunities.
pros: Prime location on Dubai Marina waterfront with stunning marina views
Multiple award-winning restaurants and sophisticated dining options
Luxurious spa and comprehensive wellness facilities
Elegant accommodations with high-end amenities and spacious layouts
cons: Busy marina location can be crowded during peak times
